01 — What we do

Ground to grade, one contractor.

ADVA’s own crews take a site from raw ground to ready-to-build — clearing, excavation, utilities, demolition and compliant environmental work, in that order.

01

Site preparation & earthwork

Clearing, mass excavation, structural excavation and grading that sets the rest of the project up to succeed.

Clearing & grubbingMass excavationRough & finish grading
02

Underground utilities

Water, sewer and storm systems installed to spec — C-900 water pipe, sanitary sewer and storm drain for new development and infrastructure work.

C-900 waterSanitary sewerStorm drain
03

Demolition & hauling

Structural demolition and interior/selective tear-out, with debris hauling handled by the same crew that brings the structure down.

StructuralInterior / selectiveDebris hauling
Turnkey site packages

Demolition, site work and abatement under one contract — the way ADVA delivered the multi-residential package in Lakewood. See past performance ↓

04

Environmental remediation

Asbestos abatement, contaminated-soil hauling and hazardous-waste compliance, staffed by ADVA’s own certified workers.

Asbestos abatementContaminated soilHazmat compliance
Now hiring — asbestos crews

Certified asbestos workers for long-duration projects, up to 70-hour weeks at peak. Apply here ↓ or in person at 720 Billings St, Unit A.

05

Flooring & drywall

Interior scopes from ADVA’s capability statement — the finish side of demolition and renovation work.

FlooringDrywallInterior build-out
One point of contact

From first walk-through to closeout, one call runs the scope — no hand-offs between trades you have to chase.

05 — Bid process

Share. Review. Mobilize.

Send the scope once. ADVA’s team reviews it as an estimating package — project, location, dates and requirements together.

01

Share plans & scope

Project type, location, dates and your plans or photos — plus bonding and prevailing-wage requirements up front.

02

Review & price

ADVA reviews quantities, crew and schedule against the scope and comes back with questions or a number.

03

Define & mobilize

Crews and equipment coordinated to your start date, with one point of contact through closeout.
